audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Lucian levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 outright, while the page's own text says levels 1-3 are Fiora's window and 6 is her cleanest all-in. It also rates the lane 8.5/10 hard on a 51.56% win rate.
audit.why: whys[0] and whys[2] and early all say levels 1-3 are yours (his single Q cannot out-damage a Vital proc + heal); whys[3] gives him 4-5; spikes[2] and mid call level 6 your reset; whys[6] and late give him two items. packet.levelChart is Fiora, Lucian, Fiora, Lucian, Skill, Fiora, Lucian.
audit.corrected: win[0], win[2], win[5] and phases[0], phases[2], phases[5] -> Fiora; win[3]/phases[3] -> Lucian; win[4]/phases[4] -> Skill. diffRating 8.5/10 -> 6/10 with breakdown.difficulty and report[14] matching.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit is tracked on every page but its cooldown is never given, and the page never says the cooldown is not a clock — his autos refund it.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.' Base is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14, so a Lucian hitting autos gets it back far sooner than 16s. The Culling is 110/100/90; Fiora W is 24s, R 110s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d now carry 16s, the auto-refund rule, 24s Riposte and 110s Grand Challenge.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] said to Riposte Relentless Pursuit — a plain dash with no damage worth parrying — and nothing states that Lightslinger's double-shot is the burst tell.
audit.why: Riot's text: any ability makes his NEXT attack a double-shot, so his damage arrives on the attack after the cast, not on the cast. Parrying the dash spends a 24s W on nothing; the parry target is The Culling. The content layer already correctly says Riposte cannot stun in this lane (no immobilize in his kit) — that stays.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].t/.d retargeted at The Culling and the auto-refunded dash; dontsFull[0].d states the no-stun rule; dontsFull[2].d names the double-shot wind-up as the step-back cue.
